decisions.reason: Height-adjustable executive desks fit the firm's premium office business and demand for flexible workspaces, so a long life cycle is likely.
A chair family is a core, scalable offering for a premium furniture maker and usually stays in the range for many years.
Floor cushions made from carpets are a niche accessory that is more likely to be cut, but they cost little to maintain alongside the rug line.
The designer sofa by EOOS was promoted prominently on the website and fits the firm's upholstery core, so it is very likely kept.
A high standing table complements the office and meeting ranges and suits modern collaborative work settings.
The rug collection rounds out the premium interior offering and supports cross-selling, so dropping it is unlikely.
